Title: Skeletal Muscle Discomfort and Lifestyle of Brazilian Military Police Officers of Administrative and Tactical Force
Population: 31 Brazilian military police officers (administrative n=15; tactical force n=16)
Exact_Result: Weekly physical-activity time did not differ significantly between administrative (454 ± 217 min/week) and tactical-force officers (623 ± 301 min/week; p=0.0832); the groups also showed no significant differences in reported musculoskeletal discomfort.
